title: The July jobs report, SpaceX earnings, and AI struggles: What to watch this week
excerpt: Investors step into another busy week, with the July jobs report and SpaceX earnings in focus.
content_html:
After last week's busiest five-day stretch of the quarter, investors will get only a small amount of relief this week. Several banner items on the agenda include the monthly nonfarm payrolls on Friday and SpaceX's (SPCX) first earnings report as a public company on Tuesday.

The S&P 500 (^GSPC) closed out Friday up 0.7%, for a gain of roughly 1.1% on the week, while the Dow (^DJI) picked up 0.5% on Friday to close the week on a similar performance of roughly 1%. The Nasdaq (^IXIC), continuing its rebound, ended Friday up 1% for a weekly gain of 1.6%.

Last week's jam-packed served, in many ways, as an excellent set-up for this week's agenda. In the earnings world, all focus will be on SpaceX in its debut earnings report after going public in the world's largest IPO on record. Elon Musk's part rocket, part AI company will have to answer the same question that faced the rest of the Big Tech hyperscalers: How much are you spending, and do the ends justify the means?

Elsewhere in the corporate world, investors will get some more AI-trade results from Palantir Technologies (PLTR) and ON Semiconductor (ON) on Monday; Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) on Tuesday; and memory giants Sandisk (SNDK) and Western Digital (WDC) on Wednesday. Outside of tech, Big Pharma leaders Eli Lilly (LLY) and Novo Nordisk (NVO) report on Wednesday, alongside the Walt Disney Company (DIS), while energy giants ConocoPhillips (COP) and Constellation Energy (CEG) report Thursday.

On the economic data calendar, all eyes will be on a slew of labor market data, with JOLTS data on Tuesday, ADP private employment data on Wednesday, jobless claims numbers on Thursday, and all of it capped off by the marquee nonfarm payrolls report on Friday.

Labor market in focus

In the months since Kevin Warsh was confirmed as Fed chairman, he has used nearly all of his public comments to talk about inflation and his commitment to bringing it to heel at 2%.

By comparison, he's barely talked about the other side of the Fed's mandate: the labor market, which will come under test this week with a jobs report and more.

Friday's jobs report is expected to show 88,000 payrolls were added in July, advancing well over June's 57,000 jobs added. Even though those levels are below the 100,000+ jobs added per month in late 2025, economists broadly consider them healthy, and a release in line (or weaker) will support the Fed's decision to hold off on raising rates.

But Wednesday's decision from the FOMC wasn't exactly met with welcome. The 30-year Treasury bond yield pushed above 5.2% to reach its highest level since 2007 on Wednesday, while the 10-year on Friday marked its highest level since January 2025.

content_html_zh:
在经历了上周本季度最繁忙的五天之后，投资者本周只会得到一点缓解。 议程上的几个重要项目包括周五的月度非农就业数据和周二 SpaceX (SPCX) 作为上市公司的首份收益报告。

标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 周五收盘上涨 0.7%，本周上涨约 1.1%，而道指 (^DJI) 周五上涨 0.5%，本周收盘表现类似，约为 1%。 纳斯达克指数 (^IXIC) 继续反弹，周五收盘上涨 1%，周涨幅为 1.6%。

上周的会议在很多方面都为本周的议程做了很好的准备。 在财报领域，所有的焦点都将集中在 SpaceX 在其首次公开募股的财报上，这是有史以来全球规模最大的 IPO。 埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）这家一半是火箭、一半是人工智能的公司将不得不回答其他大型科技超大规模企业面临的同样问题：你花了多少钱，目的是否证明手段合理？

在企业界的其他地方，投资者将于周一从 Palantir Technologies (PLTR) 和 ON Semiconductor (ON) 获得更多人工智能交易结果； Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 周二；周三，存储器巨头Sandisk（SNDK）和西部数据（WDC）。 在科技领域之外，大型制药巨头礼来公司 (LLY) 和诺和诺德公司 (NVO) 以及华特迪士尼公司 (DIS) 将于周三发布报告，而能源巨头康菲石油公司 (COP) 和星座能源 (CEG) 周四也发布报告。

在经济数据日历上，所有人的目光都将集中在一系列劳动力市场数据上，包括周二的 JOLTS 数据、周三的 ADP 私人就业数据、周四的失业救济人数，以及周五的非农就业报告。

劳动力市场成为焦点

自凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 被确认担任美联储主席以来的几个月里，他几乎所有的公开言论都在谈论通胀以及他将通胀率控制在 2% 的承诺。

相比之下，他几乎没有谈论美联储职责的另一面：劳动力市场，本周将因就业报告等而受到考验。

周五的就业报告预计将显示 7 月份新增就业岗位 88,000 个，远超 6 月份新增的 57,000 个就业岗位。 尽管这些水平低于 2025 年末每月新增 10 万多个就业岗位，但经济学家普遍认为这些就业岗位是健康的，并且符合（或更弱）的数据将支持美联储推迟加息的决定。

但联邦公开市场委员会周三的决定并没有受到欢迎。 周三，30年期国债收益率升至5.2%以上，达到2007年以来的最高水平，周五10年期国债收益率则创下2025年1月以来的最高水平。
